other_conditions: Applicant must have at least 0.5 hectares of cultivable land in a single plot registered in their name.
benefits_summary: Subsidy of up to 50% of construction cost (capped at ₹52,500 for raw ponds and ₹75,000 for plastic‑lined ponds), with an additional subsidy of up to 60% of total cost (capped at ₹63,000 for raw ponds and ₹90,000 for plastic‑lined ponds).
